qualification: Verity-protected root is evidenced against the assembled image by the verify suite, and A/B fallback by the U-Boot sandbox handshake suite executing the shipped boot.cmd. I2 is pending provisioned production trust anchors and on-board tampered-bundle/rollback negative suites, which this tree does not carry. CONFIG_FIT_SIGNATURE is configured nowhere (docs/design/boards.md section 8), so nothing left of the verity root is verified and no claim above I1 is made.

physicalBoundaries.jtag: Open on the bench; no closed or fused state is documented or enforced for any revision (docs/design/manufacturing.md section 6).
physicalBoundaries.serialConsole: Present in the field with a login prompt only; no account accepts a credential (docs/design/access.md section 2).
physicalBoundaries.recoveryPath: rockusb SoC loader mode, open to anyone with physical access; it is the recovery path and the stated physical-access boundary (docs/design/manufacturing.md section 6).
